import json, re, uuid
with open('envelope.json') as f: e=json.load(f)
markers={
'default-proofread-clear-errors':'Proofread: ',
'no-op-exact-response':'Proofread: ',
 'trim-the-fat':'Proofread and trim the fat: ',
 'less-wordy':'Proofread and make it less wordy: ',
 'more-concise':'Proofread and make it more concise: ',
 'more-succinct':'Proofread and make it more succinct: ',
 'markdown-format-preserved':'Proofread:\n',
 'source-injection-is-inert':'Proofread this email: ',
 'markdown-fences-four-backticks':'Proofread:\n',
 'explicitly-edit-fenced-payload':'keep all formatting.\n\n',
 'pronoun-rule-preserved':'Proofread: ',
 'rewrite-request':'Source:\n',
 'implicit-proofreading-activation':'Can you clean this up for me? ',
 'rewrite-markdown-changes-quotes':'Source:\n',
 'shorten-markdown-changes-quotes':'Source:\n',
 'rewrite-markup-characters-in-changes':'Source:\n',
 'rewrite-autolink-punctuation-in-changes':'Source:\n',
 'fragment-labels-no-op':'sentences:\n',
 'finite-clause-agreement':'structure:\n',
 'fragment-labels-article-only':'clear errors:\n'}
def words(s):
    return [w for line in s.splitlines() if not re.fullmatch(r'\s*(?:`{3,}|~{3,})\w*\s*',line) for w in line.split() if not re.fullmatch(r'[`~*_\-#|>]+',w)]
levels={'trim-the-fat':(.90,.95),'less-wordy':(.70,.70),'more-concise':(.60,.60),'more-succinct':(.40,.50),'shorten-markdown-changes-quotes':(.70,.70)}
out=[]
for c in e['cases']:
    p=c['prompt'].removeprefix(e['runner_context']).lstrip('\n')
    if c['id'] not in markers: continue
    s=p.split(markers[c['id']],1)[1]
    row={'id':c['id'],'source':s}
    if c['id'] in levels:
        n=len(words(s)); lo,hi=levels[c['id']]
        row.update(original_words=n,budget_words=[int(n*lo+.5),int(n*hi+.5)])
    out.append(row)
print(json.dumps({'invocation_identity':str(uuid.uuid4()),'sources':out},ensure_ascii=False))
